lines.text: Here is the same separator in three dimensions, with the front half of the shell cut away.
The well stream enters on the left and strikes the inlet diverter.
Gas travels along the top, through the mist extractor, and out of the gas outlet nozzle.
Underneath, water settles to the bottom while condensate floats on top of it.
The condensate spills over the weir into its own compartment, and each liquid leaves through its own nozzle.
Notice the two saddles. One is fixed, and the other is allowed to slide as the vessel expands with temperature.
